verdict.rationale: Capacities has no headless binary or CLI. Automation is possible through its REST API, which uses bearer-token auth suited to unattended scripts and publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, a TypeScript SDK and documented rate limits. It also offers MCP integration for custom agents and scheduled automated full exports. The current Beta API is deprecated as of September 1, 2026, and integrations must move to the successor portal. Missing for 10: a CLI or headless runtime, any CI-specific docs or examples (e.g. a GitHub Action), and independent hands-on reports of CI automation.
